hero.h1: I build websites that bring in clients
hero.sub: Showcase sites, catalogs with quote requests and custom platforms, with an admin panel so you can manage your content yourself. Hosting, launch and security included.

services.title: A complete website, from mockup to launch.
services.intro: I handle everything: design, development, admin panel and hosting. You stay in control of your content.

s1.title: Showcase website
s1.desc: Present your business with a fast, clear website that looks like you, and update it yourself.

s2.title: Catalog & quotes
s2.desc: Your products online, organized and filterable, with a guided quote request that lands straight in your inbox.

s3.title: Custom platform
s3.desc: Member areas, sign-ups, rankings, dashboards: a web app built around the way you work.

s4.title: Security & hosting
s4.desc: Domain name, hosting, HTTPS and launch: I take care of the technical side, with a cybersecurity student’s eye.

projects.title: Real projects, delivered with their own admin panel.
projects.intro: Every site is built so its owner can update it on their own, without calling me to change a photo.

method.title: Five clear steps, no surprises.
method.intro: You always know where your project stands and what you get at each step.

s1.d: We talk about your business, goals and content. I send you a clear quote.

s2.d: I design your pages for desktop and mobile. You approve them before any code is written.

s3.d: I build the site and its admin panel, which you test on a preview link.

s4.d: Domain, hosting, HTTPS: I publish the site and show you how to manage it.

s5.d: I stay available for fixes, new features and updates.

about.title: Future cybersecurity engineer, web developer every day.
about.intro: Security isn’t an add-on at the end: I build it into every site from the first mockup.
